title: RoyalPixels
description: RoyalPixels is a Minigames Network running on the latest Minecraft version – no modpack required! Play MaceRoyal, SkyWars, and host your own custom Events like All vs One or Half Heart Race.
body:
⚔️ Welcome to RoyalPixels – Where Every Match is a Battle for Glory! ⚔️

Are you ready to dominate the arena? RoyalPixels is the ultimate Minigames Network packed with fast-paced action, player-driven events, and high-stakes competition. Whether you're swinging for survival or racing on the edge, there's always something epic waiting for you!

## 🏹 Game Modes

Step into the action with our signature game modes:

🔨 **MaceRoyal** – Known as **MaceRoulette** in the US – the chaotic, adrenaline-fueled showdown where only the boldest survive!

🌤️ **SkyWars (12x1)** – Classic island combat taken to the next level. Gear up, gear fast, and outlast every opponent!

## 🎉 A Community-Powered Event System

RoyalPixels puts the power in **YOUR** hands! Host and join custom player-run events anytime:

- ⚔️ **All vs One** – Can one player hold off the entire server?
- 💛 **Half Heart Race** – Who dares to go the farthest with just half a heart?
- 🏝️ **Private SkyWars** – Your island, your rules, your friends!
- 🔨 **Private MaceRoyal** – Set up your own private Mace madness!

## 👑 Rise Through the Ranks

Compete, conquer, and carve your name into the RoyalPixels leaderboards. Every match is a chance to prove you're the best — or come back swinging harder.
